subject.title: [Feature] Per-kind verbose output: commentary/narration without tool summaries

question: Should OpenClaw support narration-only progress as the session-level `/verbose commentary` preset proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103991, while leaving persisted `verboseDefault` unchanged?
rationale: This is a new cross-channel interaction mode rather than a repair to an established contract; maintainers need to decide whether the session-only product semantics are desirable before implementation can be accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the session-only preset
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if its shared-lane behavior and session-only compatibility boundary match the intended product direction.

options.title: Narrow or defer the direction
options.body: Close or reshape the linked PR if commentary-only progress should remain channel-specific or needs a separate persisted-default design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the session-only preset
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if its shared-lane behavior and session-only compatibility boundary match the intended product direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged durable-commentary implementation is the closest established feature-history ownership signal for the shared verbose delivery behavior.
